alt: An annotated SC-109 Authorization to Appear form filed in Case 26AVSC00192 (Nicolas Hernandez v. Local Initiative Health Authority of Los Angeles County) on May 19, 2026. Annotated by Nicolas Hernandez to highlight four key audit points: Felix Huerta's Paralegal title as an agency representative proxy, the physical headquarters address at 1200 W. 7th St confirming operational venue, the Checked Box 3d declaring L.A. Care's legal status as a government agency/public entity, and the sworn perjury signature confirming statutory statement scope of duty. The annotations also deconstruct the 'Public Entity Paradox' exposing how L.A. Care asserts public status in court while neglecting basic public directory transparency.
summary: This annotated Judicial Council Form SC-109 (Authorization to Appear), signed under penalty of perjury on May 19, 2026, authorizes Felix Huerta, listing his job title as 'Paralegal', to represent the Local Initiative Health Authority of Los Angeles County (operating as L.A. Care Health Plan) in Small Claims Case 26AVSC00192. Checked box 3(d) formally declares L.A. Care is a government agency or public entity, establishing the legal basis for L.A. Care's Gov. Code § 905 defense. Annotations clinically deconstruct how this sworn filing locks in operational headquarters venue at 1200 W. 7th St, establishes representation under general counsel direction, and exposes the 'Public Entity Paradox' where L.A. Care claims public status to shield themselves in court while printing defunct addresses next to their public status in member letter footers.

42011 4th Street West
Lancaster, CA 93534
Fill in your case number and case name below:
Case Number: 26AVSC00192
Case Name: Nicolas Hernandez v. Local Initiative Health Authority of Los Angeles County

This form is used to tell the court you are authorized to appear for a plaintiff or defendant in a small claims case. You may also use this form to ask the court for permission to help a plaintiff or defendant who cannot properly present their claim or defense. If you are a lawyer, you can appear only as authorized by Code of Civil Procedure section 116.530. 
After you fill out this form, file it with the small claims clerk at or before the trial.

1. Your name, address, and position:
Name: Felix Huerta
Address: 1200 West 7th Street • Los Angeles, CA 90017
Job title or relationship to the plaintiff or defendant you want to appear for or assist: Paralegal

2. Who are you appearing for?
A defendant in this case (name): Local Initiative Health Authority of Los Angeles County

3. Tell us about the plaintiff or defendant you are appearing for.
I am authorized to appear for a (check one; if you are asking to appear in court to assist a plaintiff or defendant who cannot properly present their claim or defense without assistance, skip this item and complete 4 instead):
d. Government agency or other public entity and I am an employee, officer, or director of that agency or entity. Representing the agency or entity in small claims court is not the only duty of my job.

SC-109, Page 1 of 2
(More options on next page)

USER ANNOTATIONS ON EVIDENCE ASSET:
--------------------------------------------------
1. [RED BOX around "Government agency or other public entity"]
   Annotation: "Sworn Public Agency Status Verification: By checking box 3(d), Paralegal Felix Huerta formally declares under penalty of perjury that L.A. Care is a 'government agency or other public entity.' This sworn court filing provides the irrefutable judicial admission required to validate Gov. Code § 905 applicability, locking L.A. Care into their public agency obligations and forcing the formal Government Tort Claim compliance track."

2. [BLUE BOX around address "1200 West 7th Street"]
   Annotation: "Verification of Active Operational Headquarters: Huerta lists his business address as 1200 West 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017. This formal, sworn court statement provides irrevocable legal proof of L.A. Care's active physical headquarters, completely neutralizing their standard 'defective service of process' evasion claims and verifying their active venue for future litigation (Case 26AVSC00192.2)."

3. [ORANGE BOX around title "Paralegal"]
   Annotation: "The Paralegal Court Proxy (CCP § 116.540): The form documents Huerta's role as a 'Paralegal' within the Legal Division, proving that L.A. Care bypasses the small claims attorney exclusion (CCP § 116.530) by employing an in-house paralegal as a corporate representative to execute pre-drafted legal scripts directed by counsel."

4. [THE PUBLIC ENTITY PARADOX: "Government agency or other public entity"]
   Annotation: "The Public Entity Paradox: While L.A. Care's Legal Division formally files this sworn SC-109 form under penalty of perjury asserting their status as a 'government agency or public entity' to shield themselves in court, they concurrently publish their defunct address at 1055 W. 7th Street in their letter footers next to the text 'A public entity serving Los Angeles County.' They demand public agency immunities while neglecting public transparency."
